title: Advances and developments in transition metal-free benzylic C(sp3)–H activation/functionalization reactions
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,14691-14716
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00361J, Review Article
Open Access

Fatemeh Doraghi, Shahab Kermaninia, Elika Salehi Ghalehsefid, Bagher Larijani, Mohammad Mahdavi
Transition metal-free benzylic C(sp3)–H activation is a direct strategy for forming C–C and C–X bonds. This review highlights C–H activation/annulation or C–H activation/functionalization of toluenes using non-metal catalysts or non-metal promoters.
